Claire Z., a Canadian researcher of Chinese origin and an intern at NATO’s military headquarters — the Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE) — arrested on suspicions of espionage, is an AI researcher who has previously worked for multiple other international organizations and who might have provided China with sensitive information. Z. arrived in the Belgian town of Mons in July 2025 to begin her internship in SHAPE’s IT department. She extended her initial 6-month term to a year. Just before her internship ended, police raided her student room in Mons and her workplace at NATO on July 23. The next day, Z. was arrested. She is suspected of “espionage on behalf of a third country and participation in a criminal organisation”. Z., who speaks fluent Chinese and English, specializes in AI. In 2022, she obtained a Master’s degree in computer science from a Canadian university and subsequently wrote several academic papers, the most recent of which examined how AI that detects patterns can be better protected against hostile attacks. Canadian authorities had given approval for her internship. “She held a security clearance issued by Canada,” a security official said, adding that while she could have collected some intelligence helpful for Chinese authorities, access to classified information was only shared on a need-to-know basis. Z. came to the attention of SHAPE’s internal counter-intelligence service, which shared the information with the Belgian General Intelligence and Security Service (ADIV) “because it observed that the young Canadian woman was exhibiting behaviour that went beyond that of a mere intern at NATO”. According to another security official, Z. was seen hanging around NATO’s buildings and was frequently asking hypothetical questions about breaches of security protocols. “She displayed suspicious behaviour that was picked up on. Recently, more attention has been paid to the Chinese threat. Perhaps colleagues asked themselves: what is that Chinese woman doing here?” ￼ Interns at SHAPE could gather a significant amount of information that could be of interest to Chinese intelligence services, such as people’s names and identities, internal security procedures, and building plans, as well as routes of guards and locations of CCTV cameras. NATO is not the first European or international organization where Z. has worked. Her social media accounts show that she previously undertook a 10-month internship at the European Space Agency’s (ESA) research centre in Italy. She also worked at the WTO in Switzerland and for various Canadian government organizations. Further investigation will have to determine whether Z. was indeed carrying out intelligence work, and whether this was done on behalf of China. (This would fit into China’s playbook.) “We know that the Chinese government makes extensive use of its diaspora for espionage and influence operations. At the same time, Beijing can use the fact that she is not Chinese to its advantage. New Working Paper | EU Sustainability Regulations: Implications for India's Rice Exports India is the world's largest rice exporter, accounting for 29% of global exports worth USD 11.8 billion in 2024. The EU is a strategically important market, especially for basmati, but rice was excluded from tariff elimination under the India-EU FTA, leaving India at a price disadvantage against FTA-advantaged competitors like Viet Nam. Meanwhile, over 200 rapid alert notifications against Indian rice in the last five years, mainly for banned pesticide residues, point to widening compliance gaps. Drawing on trade data, RASFF notifications, and firm-level case studies, Arpita Mukherjee and Ria Babbar assess India's rice value chain against the EU's evolving environmental, labour, and corporate-accountability standards. They identify six environmental and four labour risks needing urgent attention, and call for farm-level traceability and use of the India-EU FTA to secure mutual recognition of India's audit and certification systems. The majority of FPO members are women from marginalized communities. The initiative represents an important step towards demonstrating how clean energy, sustainable agriculture, and community ownership can come together to create resilient and inclusive rural livelihoods. It's completely unnecessary to destroy books when machines like this exist. This book scanner by Treventus for example, can scan fragile books without destroying it. Video Hedgie (@HedgieMarkets) 🦔AI companies are bulk-buying rare books, scanning them through high-speed machines that cut the spines off, and shredding the originals. A service called ISBNdb facilitates orders of up to a million books and keeps buyers anonymous. Pre-2022 books are premium because they're free of AI-generated text. A federal judge ruled the practice is fair use because eliminating the original means only one copy exists at a time. Anthropic hired the former head of Google Books partnerships to obtain "all the books in the world." My Take This got to me. A bookseller told 404 Media that rare books with almost no surviving copies are being fed into this pipeline. Books that survived wars, fires, and centuries of handling are being shredded so an AI can learn to write a better marketing email. ISBNdb's website literally says "'AI company destroys two million books' is not a headline that generates sympathy," and they still built an entire business around making it happen quietly. They offer NDAs as a feature. They coach clients to call it "digital preservation." I've covered AI companies scraping the internet, torrenting libraries, and stealing music. This is worse because it's irreversible. You can re-upload a website. You can reprint a bestseller. You can't replace the last three copies of an 18th-century botanical text once someone shreds them for training data. And the judge said it's legal. So it's going to accelerate. "We shred rare books and offer NDAs so nobody finds out" is a legitimate business model in 2026. What a timeline. Hedgie🤗 — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/HedgieMarkets/status/2081534588485296565#m

Electronic warfare, DRFM jamming, and networked sensors likely played a decisive role in breaking the missile’s terminal guidance, forcing it to lose lock and fall short of its intended target. Modern air combat isn’t just missile vs aircraft. It’s seeker vs jammer. Network vs network. Instead of sending fighters to destroy every radar, launcher or command post, the IAF can launch waves of attritable loitering munitions that saturate air defences and force the enemy into an expensive defensive battle. With a roadmap extending to 1,500 km, Sureshastra is evolving into a layered strike family designed for the networked battlefield. The future won’t be won by the most expensive platform. It will be won by the force that can sustain precision at scale. #OSINT #IAF #DroneWarfare

287 million people are living with #hepatitis B or C, and 1.3 million people died from viral hepatitis last year. On #WorldHepatitisDay, I call on world leaders to help us break down the barriers that keep people from accessing hepatitis prevention, testing and treatment, all of which are lifesaving services. Let’s turn science into action and end viral hepatitis as a public health threat.

At the @AIDS_conference, @WHO launched the mid-term assessment of the Global Health Sector Strategies on HIV, viral hepatitis and sexually transmitted infections (2022–2030). The report shows: -By the end of 2025, an estimated 32 million people living with #HIV were receiving treatment. -Since 2010, new HIV infections have fallen by 43% and AIDS-related deaths by 57%. -Yet 9 million people still lack access to life-saving HIV treatment. -Since 2015, annual hepatitis B infections have declined by 32% and hepatitis C deaths by 12%. -But viral hepatitis still claimed an estimated 1.3 million lives in 2024, with overall mortality continuing to rise. -STI policies have strengthened, but rising infections and drug-resistant gonorrhea threaten progress. This report tells two stories. It shows what is possible when countries invest in health, science and communities. But it also shows how quickly progress can be reversed by funding cuts, humanitarian crises and persistent inequalities: bit.ly/4c4Cxsa

Today we celebrate the birthdays of two physicists: Bertram B. Boltwood and Friedrich Ernst Dorn! Boltwood and Dorn both contributed to our current understanding of radioactivity. Boltwood laid a theoretical foundation for the concept of isotopes — atoms with a different number of neutrons from a parent element. Dorn conducted experiments based on Marie and Pierre Curie’s discoveries, which led him to uncover new clues about a gas coming from radium compounds. This was later found to be the chemical element we now call Radon (Rn).

What can four decades of land cover data reveal? A changing landscape. The latest release of the Annual National Land Cover Database (NLCD) extends annual mapping through 2025, providing a longer view of how landscapes across the United States have changed over time. One example is the Great Salt Lake in Utah. In the mid-1980s, the lake’s water levels reached historic highs. Since then, water levels have fluctuated over the years but have declined overall. Built from Landsat imagery, Annual NLCD maps land cover across the United States each year, helping researchers, government agencies, businesses, and communities better understand how landscapes are changing. Learn more about the latest Annual NLCD release, including how to access and download the data: 👉ow.ly/yPls50ZqOWp 🎥: Animation showing Annual NLCD maps of the Great Salt Lake area in Utah (1985 to 2025). Darker blue represents open water, while lighter blues represent wetlands. Shades of green signify various types of forests. Shades of red represent developed areas, including cities and roads, with darker shades indicating more intense development. Light tan is grassland; darker tan is shrub/scrub land cover; yellow is pasture/hay; and brown is cropland. Gray is barren land. Video

FMINO PRESS RELEASE INFORMATION MINISTER HAILS NTA'S NEW WORLD CLASS STUDIO, UPGRADE OF NATIONAL PRESS CENTRE The Honourable Minister of Information and National Orientation, Mohammed Idris, has expressed satisfaction with the newly completed world-class television studio at the Nigerian Television Authority (NTA) Headquarters and the ongoing upgrade of the National Press Centre, describing both projects as clear evidence of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu's commitment to modernising Nigeria's public information infrastructure. The Minister made the remarks on Monday after inspecting the facilities in Abuja. He said the investments form part of the Federal Government's broader efforts to reposition government-owned media organisations to deliver quality public service broadcasting and information to Nigerians. "What we have seen today is the fulfilment of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu's promise to modernise Nigeria's public broadcasting facilities. This is one of the best studios in Nigeria and among the finest on the African continent," the Minister said. He noted that the newly completed NTA studio ranks among the best broadcast facilities in Africa and forms part of a broader investment programme across the Nigerian Television Authority (NTA), the Federal Radio Corporation of Nigeria (FRCN), the Voice of Nigeria (VON) and the News Agency of Nigeria (NAN). The Minister commended the management and staff of the NTA for supporting the transformation process, adding that the reforms extend beyond infrastructure to improved content, professionalism, innovation and human capacity development. He said the ongoing procurement of modern broadcast equipment for NTA stations nationwide, alongside investments in other government media organisations, would significantly improve public service broadcasting across the country. Idris also described the recently relaunched Digital Switch Over (DSO) programme as a major milestone that complements the ongoing modernisation of Nigeria's broadcasting industry. "The Digital Switch Over and the investments in modern broadcast infrastructure are opening a new chapter for Nigeria's information sector. By the time this reform programme is completed, Nigerians will witness a truly transformed public broadcasting system." The Minister further disclosed that President Tinubu is equally committed to improving the welfare of workers in the information sector, stressing that the administration recognises the importance of investing in both infrastructure and personnel. Following the inspection of the NTA facilities, the Minister visited the National Press Centre at Radio House, where he expressed satisfaction with the progress of the ongoing renovation. He said the upgraded National Press Centre will become a modern media hub equipped with world-class facilities and high-speed internet connectivity to support journalists covering government activities and national events. "The National Press Centre must fulfil its mandate as Nigeria's foremost media hub. It is being redesigned to provide journalists with a conducive environment and modern facilities to carry out their professional responsibilities effectively." The Minister urged the contractors to complete the project within schedule, noting that he would return for a final inspection before its commissioning. He reiterated that the ongoing upgrades across government-owned media institutions reflect President Tinubu's commitment to strengthening public communication, promoting credible information dissemination and repositioning Nigeria's information sector to meet international standards. Rabiu Ibrahim, MNIPR Special Assistant (Media) to the Honourable Minister of Information and National Orientation Monday, 27 July, 2026

Islamabad : 28 July 2026. A U.S. Congressional delegation, comprising Rep. Ryan Zinke and Rep. Michael Baumgartener, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House this afternoon. Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar, Foreign Secretary Ambassador Amna Baloch, and U.S. Chargé d’Affaires Ms. Natalie Baker were also present. During the meeting, the Prime Minister welcomed both U.S. Congressmen to Pakistan and said that their visit was a welcome step towards building stronger Pakistan-U.S. ties. While congratulating the Congressmen and the American people on the 250th anniversary of U.S. Independence, the Prime Minister also conveyed his warm regards and best wishes for President Donald Trump. The Prime Minister fondly recalled President Trump’s bold and decisive intervention that led to cessation of hostilities and ceasefire between Pakistan and India in May 2025, and helped saved hundreds of millions of lives. On bilateral relations, the Prime Minister said that Pakistan was keen to further strengthen its cooperation with the U.S. in trade, investment, agriculture, IT, mines & minerals and the energy sector. Both Congressmen thanked the Prime Minister for the warm hospitality extended to them during their visit. They noted that President Trump enjoyed excellent relations with the Pakistani leadership, which was also having a positive impact on the bilateral ties. They praised the Prime Minister for Pakistan’s leading role in regional peace efforts. The two sides agreed to increase the number and frequency of visits by Congressional delegations to Pakistan as well as visits of parliamentary delegations to the U.S. After the meeting, the Prime Minister hosted a reception in honor of a delegation of U.S. corporate sector executives who are visiting Pakistan. The delegation includes representatives of diverse sectors including IT and technology, energy, mining and manufacturing. Welcoming the delegation, the Prime Minister reaffirmed Pakistan’s commitment to strengthening its longstanding partnership with the U.S., emphasizing that economic cooperation remains a central pillar of bilateral ties. He invited more U.S. companies to invest in Pakistan in mutually beneficial ventures across a wide range of sectors. During their warm and most cordial exchange, the Prime Minister underscored that the Pakistani American diaspora, well represented among the visiting U.S. business delegation, constitutes a vital bridge between Pakistan and the United States. The reception was also attended by Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar, Federal Ministers, and senior government officials. Video

Who will constitute this Task Force? 👉 What qualifications will its officers possess? ⦿ Over the last seven years, the NTA postponed 15 examinations, while six of its 14 major examinations faced allegations of paper leaks and other discrepancies. ⦿ The NTA has only 39 permanent posts, and 15 of these posts are lying vacant. ⦿ The NTA needs a strong, permanent, professional workforce, including experts in examination administration, psychometrics, logistics, data protection, cybersecurity, and fraud detection. मोदी सरकार पहले छात्रों और युवाओं की आवाज कुचलना चाहती थी। लेकिन जब सिंहासन डोलने लगा तो सरकार आनन-फ़ानन में यह बिल लेकर आई है। सरकार ये बिल पहले भी लेकर आई थी। तमाम तरह के प्रावधान बताए गए थे और अब फिर से कमेटी बनाने, फास्ट ट्रैक कोर्ट की बात कही गई है। लेकिन सोचिए- सरकार इस मामले की सुनवाई में CBI के वकील तक को नहीं भेज सकी। हालांकि देश में चल रहे फास्ट ट्रैक कोर्ट्स का हाल भी कुछ अच्छा नहीं है। लेकिन युवाओं ने दिखा दिया कि वे जागरूक हैं। प्रदर्शन करने वाले छात्रों के हाथों में संविधान था और जुबान पर इंकलाब जिंदाबाद का नारा था। उन्होंने बता दिया प्रजातंत्र में असली राजा जनता है। देश का भविष्य जब सड़कों पर उतरा तो उन्होंने दिखा दिया कि यही मोदी सरकार का 12 साल का रिपोर्ट कार्ड है, जहां शिक्षा व्यवस्था और एग्जाम सिस्टम ध्वस्त है। लेकिन सरकार ने इन युवाओं को जिस तरीके से हैंडल किया, वह बर्बर था। जनता ये सवाल पूछ रही है- आखिर वो कौन था, जिसने छात्रों-युवाओं पर पैलेट गन चलाने, कील वाली लाठियां बरसाने और आंसू गैस के गोले दागने का आदेश दिया। : लोकसभा में 'लोक परीक्षा (अनुचित साधन निवारण) संशोधन विधेयक, 2026' पर @DeependerSHooda जी का वक्तव्य- Video

सविस्तर आढावा बैठक पार पडली. पालघर हा मुबलक पाऊस पडणारा आणि वेगाने नागरीकरण होत असलेला जिल्हा आहे. या पार्श्वभूमीवर भविष्यातील विविध प्रकारच्या आपत्ती टाळण्यासाठी प्रभावी उपाययोजना कराव्यात. अतिवृष्टी आणि महापुरामुळे बाधित कुटुंबांना नियमांतील तरतुदींपेक्षा अधिक मदत उपलब्ध करून देण्याच्या दृष्टीने विशेष पॅकेज मंजूर करण्यात येईल. त्यासाठी पालघर आणि नाशिक जिल्ह्यांसाठी एकात्मिक मदत आराखडा तयार करण्यात यावा, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री देवेंद्र फडणवीस यांनी दिले. मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, अतिवृष्टी आणि पुरामुळे बाधित नागरिकांना तातडीची मदत उपलब्ध करून देतानाच भविष्यात अशा आपत्तींचा परिणाम कमी करण्यासाठी कायमस्वरूपी पायाभूत सुविधा उभारण्यावर भर द्यावा. जनजीवन पूर्वपदावर आणण्यासाठी दळणवळण आणि रस्ते सुविधा प्राधान्याने पूर्ववत कराव्यात. यासाठी सार्वजनिक बांधकाम विभाग, ग्रामविकास विभाग आणि संबंधित यंत्रणांनी आवश्यक पूर्वनियोजन करून युद्धपातळीवर काम करावे. ऊर्जा विभागांतर्गत महावितरण आणि संबंधित कंपन्यांनी वीज वितरण व्यवस्था अधिक सक्षम करण्यासाठी पायाभूत संरचनेची पुनर्रचना करावी. आपत्तीच्या काळातही अखंडित वीजपुरवठा राखता यावा, यासाठी तिन्ही वीज कंपन्यांनी आवश्यक उपाययोजना करत इन्फ्रास्ट्रक्चरल अपग्रेडेशन करावे. तसेच, जलसाठे आणि पाण्याच्या प्रवाहांचा सखोल अभ्यास करून त्यांचे नकाशे तयार करावेत आणि त्यांचा विकास आराखड्यांमध्ये समावेश करावा, भविष्यात विकास परवानग्या देताना या अभ्यासाचा आधार घेतला जाईल, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. वसई-विरार परिसरात अतिवृष्टीच्या काळात पाणी साठविण्यासाठी ‘होल्डिंग पॉन्ड्स’ मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, वसई-विरार परिसरात अतिवृष्टीच्या काळात भौगोलिक परिस्थितीमुळे पाण्याचा निचरा होण्यास विलंब होतो. त्यामुळे पाणी साठविण्यासाठी ‘होल्डिंग पॉन्ड्स’ विकसित करण्यात यावेत. यासाठी मुदत संपलेल्या लीजवरील जागांचा वापर करण्याची कार्यवाही करावी, असे निर्देश मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी दिले. कोकण विभागातील रायगड आणि रत्नागिरी जिल्ह्यांसाठी ज्या पद्धतीने नियोजन करण्यात आले आहे, त्याच धर्तीवर महाराष्ट्र इन्स्टिट्यूशन फॉर ट्रान्सफॉर्मेशन (मित्रा)च्या माध्यमातून महाराष्ट्र प्रतिसादक्षम विकास कार्यक्रम (एमआरडीपी) अंतर्गत पालघर जिल्ह्यासाठी आराखडा तयार करण्यात यावा. त्यामुळे पायाभूत विकास अधिक सक्षम होईल आणि जागतिक बँकेचा निधी उपलब्ध करून घेण्यासही मदत होईल. पालघर जिल्ह्यातील भूभागाचे मॅपिंग करून बेस मॅप तयार करावा. या नकाशांचा उपयोग विकास प्रकल्पांचे नियोजन, पाणी निचरा व्यवस्था आणि भविष्यातील विकास आराखडे तयार करण्यासाठी करण्यात यावा. समृद्धी महामार्गाच्या कामात अशा प्रकारच्या नियोजनाचे सकारात्मक परिणाम दिसून आले असून, पालघरमध्येही त्याच धर्तीवर नियोजन करावे, असे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी नमूद केले. अधिक मदतीसाठी विशेष पॅकेज मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस म्हणाले, एकात्मिक मदत आराखड्यास तातडीने मंजुरी देण्यात येईल. यापूर्वी कोल्हापूर येथील महापुराच्या वेळी अशा प्रकारची मदत देण्यात आली होती. नुकसानग्रस्त घरे आणि दुकाने यांचे पंचनामे जलदगतीने पूर्ण करावेत. रस्ते व इतर पायाभूत सुविधांचे सर्वेक्षण करून जिल्हाधिकारी आणि मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकाऱ्यांनी आवश्यक कार्यवाही करावी. तात्काळ आणि दीर्घकालीन मदतीसाठी आवश्यक प्रस्ताव त्वरित सादर करावेत. या कामांसाठी आवश्यक निधी शासन उपलब्ध करून देईल. पालघरमधील मदत व पुनर्वसन कार्यात केंद्र शासन आणि राज्य शासनाचे विविध विभाग सहभागी असून, या सर्व विभागांची संयुक्त आढावा बैठक लवकरच घेण्यात येणार असल्याचे मुख्यमंत्री फडणवीस यांनी सांगितले. अतिवृष्टीबाधितांसाठी मदत, पुनर्वसन आणि पायाभूत विकास आराखड्यावर चर्चा या बैठकीत जिल्ह्यातील अतिवृष्टीमुळे पालघर, डहाणू आणि तलासरी तालुक्यांतील सुमारे 4197 बाधित कुटुंबांना अन्नधान्य तसेच आर्थिक मदत वितरित करण्यात आल्याची माहिती देण्यात आली. सूर्या नदी, कवडसा तसेच सूर्या धरण परिसरात अतिवृष्टीमुळे साचलेल्या पाण्याचा निचरा होण्यासाठी 48 तासांहून अधिक कालावधी लागल्याची माहिती बैठकीत देण्यात आली. त्यामुळे अनेक घरे दीर्घकाळ पाण्याखाली राहिल्याने मोठ्या प्रमाणात कुटुंबांचे नुकसान झाले असून, त्यांना मदत, पंचनामे आणि पुनर्वसनासाठी घरे उपलब्ध करून देण्याबाबत चर्चा झाली. पूरस्थितीचा दीर्घकालीन परिणाम कमी करण्यासाठी साठवण तलाव (होल्डिंग पॉन्ड्स) उभारण्याचा प्रस्तावही बैठकीत मांडण्यात आला. तसेच, वसई लिंक आणि नालासोपारा परिसरात अतिवृष्टीच्या काळात संपर्क तुटणाऱ्या भागांमध्ये कायमस्वरूपी दळणवळण व्यवस्था निर्माण करण्यावर भर देण्यात आला. याशिवाय, पूरामुळे नुकसान झालेल्या पायाभूत सुविधांची पुनर्बांधणी, संरक्षक बांध व रस्त्यांची दुरुस्ती, जलशुद्धीकरण प्रकल्पाच्या (डब्ल्यूटीपी) नुकसानीची भरपाई, रस्त्यांचे पुनर्निर्माण, मोऱ्या व पुलांची उंची वाढविणे तसेच उघड्या गटारांचे बांधकाम आदी कामांसाठी एकूण ₹584.45 कोटीच्या प्रस्तावावर सविस्तर चर्चा करण्यात आली. या कामांना गती देऊन तातडीने कार्यवाही करण्याच्या सूचना संबंधित विभागांना देण्यात आल्या. यावेळी मंत्री गिरीष महाजन, मंत्री गणेश नाईक, मंत्री शिवेंद्रसिंहराजे भोसले, राज्यमंत्री ॲड. आशिष जयस्वाल, इतर आमदार व वरिष्ठ अधिकारी उपस्थित होते. @Dev_Fadnavis @girishdmahajan @NaikSpeaks Devlet olarak bir taraftan tüm imkânlarımızla afetzedelerimizin yardımına koşarken diğer taraftan da bu çevrelerce köpürtülen dezenformasyonla mücadele etmek zorunda kaldık. Son haftalarda ortaya dökülen bilgi ve belgeler, 53 binden fazla canımızı toprağa verdiğimiz 6 Şubat depremleri sürecinde neler yaşandığını, hangi oyunların çevrildiğini, devlete ve millete hangi operasyonların çekildiğini, deprem bölgesine ayak basmamış terbiye yoksunu tiplerin nasıl hariçten gazel okuduğunu hepimize çok net biçimde gösteriyor. Kimlerin kimlerle hangi çarpık ilişkiler içinde olduğu tek tek ortaya çıkıyor. Aynı zamanda bunların hesabı yargımız tarafından soruluyor. Depremi kullanarak siyasi ve ekonomik fırsatçılık yapanlar bugün adalete hesap veriyor. Bir defa şunun bilinmesini isterim: “Suimisalin emsal olmaması” için hukuk zemininde ne gerekiyorsa mutlaka yapacağız. Bunda son derece kararlıyız. Ucu nereye varırsa varsın, bundan böyle bu ülkede gerilimden, kutuplaşmadan, korku ve kaygı yaymaktan medet umanların ellerindeki imkânları devlete karşı bir silah olarak kullanmalarına fırsat vermeyeceğiz.

Dezenformasyonun her çeşidiyle mücadeleyi ülkemiz, demokrasimiz ve toplumsal barışımız açısından bir millî güvenlik meselesi olarak görüyoruz. Çünkü günümüzde dezenformasyon yanlış bilgi yaymanın ötesine geçmiş; biz dâhil toplumların birlik ve güven duygusunu zayıflatan, demokrasileri tehdit eden asimetrik bir unsura dönüşmüştür. Dezenformasyonla mücadelemizi bu anlayışla meselenin taşıdığı hayati önem doğrultusunda kararlılıkla sürdüreceğiz.

When you look inside a reactor’s core, do you notice that captivating blue glow? That is the ‘Cherenkov effect’ at work! It is named after the physicist who was born #onthisday in 1904. While studying the effects of radiation emitted by sources such as radium, passing through various fluids, Pavel Cherenkov observed a blue-ish light emitted by a radioactive source placed in water. This phenomenon was later explained by Igor Tamm and Ilya Frank: charged particles are disturbing electrons as the particles move faster than the speed of light in the insulating medium like water. This is the ‘Cherenkov effect,’ and he along with Tamm and Frank earned the 1958 @NobelPrize in Physics "for the discovery and the interpretation of the Cherenkov effect". 🔗atoms.iaea.org/4fyYErJ Video

How can food systems create economic opportunity? Food is essential to nutrition, health and well-being. For millions of rural people, it is also a source of livelihood. When agricultural production is effectively marketed, processed and traded, it can generate income, create jobs and drive broader rural transformation. In Cambodia, IFAD’s ASPIRE programme has supported this transition. One example is Kampot pepper – a geographical indication product now reaching international markets, including Germany, where its recognized value has opened new opportunities for small-scale producers. Between 2014 and 2022, ASPIRE reached more than 143,000 households, helping farmers move from informal local trading to more structured commercial relationships. IFAD impact assessments show that participating farmers increased market sales volumes by 41% on average and incomes by more than 50%. By strengthening productivity and market linkages, the programme helped build a value chain connecting Cambodian small-scale producers to both domestic and export markets. Since 2017, IFAD-supported cooperatives have supplied Kampot pepper to Germany’s Fuchs Group, Europe’s largest spice manufacturer – enabling farmers to secure more competitive prices, reduce uncertainty and plan production more effectively. Saurav Das (@SauravDassss) 🚨URGENT STATEMENT🚨 The interim order passed by the Supreme Court of India in the batch of PILs related to the CJP protest must ring alarm bells across the country. In particular, Direction No. 4, which permits governments to proceed with existing FIRs and carry out investigations, raises extremely serious concerns. This direction stands in direct contradiction to the solemn assurance and guarantee extended by the Government of India to the youth of this nation on 25 July 2026, namely, that the FIRs would be withdrawn and that no protester would be directly or indirectly targeted for participating in the peaceful movement. It was on the strength of that solemn assurance, and in complete good faith, that the Cockroach Janta Party called off its nationwide protest. We now have a credible apprehension that the Government of India and BJP-ruled states may seek to use and weaponise this order of the Bench led by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant to continue FIRs against individual protesters and subject them to great harassment. This was precisely our concern from day one: that courts could be used, directly or indirectly, to achieve political ends by targeting peaceful dissent. Equally troubling is the fact that the interim order was not opposed by the government's lawyers, despite the Central Government being fully aware that talks/assurances with the CJP had continued until as recently as late last night and that a solemn agreement had already been arrived at on 25 July. The court's uninformed order is therefore wholly unacceptable. A solemn public assurance given to thousands of young students and protesters cannot be diluted, undermined, or rendered meaningless through subsequent legal developments, in a surreptitious manner. It only results in breach of public trust. In any event, nothing in the interim order prevents the Government of India or the concerned BJP/NDA ruled State Governments from withdrawing the FIRs or deciding not to proceed against peaceful protesters, like done by Bihar and Assam governments. The power to withdraw or not pursue such cases continues to rest with the executive. The court has not mandated that governments must definitely continue with the FIRs. That would be a deliberate misreading. The Government must not invoke the Court’s order as a justification for reneging on the commitment it made on 25 July. We therefore demand that the Government of India and the concerned BJP/NDA State Governments immediately place the terms of this solemn assurance before the Supreme Court in the pending proceedings so that there is complete transparency regarding the commitments already made to the youth of this country and so that the court can withdraw and make an informed order in the future. The youth of India entered into this understanding in good faith. That good faith must not be betrayed. Institutions of constitutional importance must never be politicised and weaponised to not honour the guarantees. The deadline for the Government of India to honour its guarantees expires today. We once again call upon it to fulfil every commitment it made: withdraw the FIRs, ensure that no protester is subjected to future punitive action, and honour both the letter and the spirit of the assurance that brought an end to the protest. Reaffirming the pledge to protect the environment, the 64th Battalion of the Sashastra Seema Bal (SSB) conducted a massive tree plantation drive at Delaisri Picnic Spot in Bogajuli under Tamulpur district. The initiative, carried out under the theme of environmental conservation saw the plantation of 520 saplings with the active participation of SSB personnel, the Assam Forest Department and local stakeholders reflecting a shared commitment towards building a greener and more sustainable future. As we continue to strengthen environmental conservation across Assam, our focus remains on increasing green cover, restoring ecological balance and encouraging greater public participation in protecting nature. Collaborative initiatives involving security forces, government agencies and local communities are playing an important role in preserving the state's rich natural heritage while promoting environmental awareness. Organised on July 27 under the leadership of Commandant Anuj Kumar of the 64th Battalion, SSB, Barama, the plantation drive witnessed the enthusiastic participation of personnel from the Patkijuli and Daranga Border Outposts. During the programme, 520 saplings of valuable and fruit-bearing species were planted to enhance biodiversity, improve the local environment and contribute to long-term ecological sustainability. Beyond planting trees, the officers and jawans took a collective pledge to nurture and protect every sapling, recognising that conservation is a long-term commitment. The initiative also aimed to inspire local residents and visitors to adopt environmentally responsible practices and actively participate in safeguarding nature. Our vision is to build a cleaner, greener and more climate-resilient Assam through collective action. Honored to join sheriffs from across the state of Florida today for a candid conversation about the issues that matter most to the communities they serve and how this FBI can better support the men and women doing the work on the ground. That partnership is already delivering results. Violent crime is down nearly 20% nationwide, and in Florida alone, it is down more than 13%. We discussed expanding Rapid DNA beyond its current use across just four criminal violations so state and local officers can identify violent offenders faster. We have already seen what this technology can do. During Operation Turf War in Martinsburg, West Virginia, mobile Rapid DNA helped investigators connect evidence to offenders in real time as the FBI and our partners arrested 35 gang members on firearms and narcotics offenses. We also cleared the TFO backlog, reduced administrative burdens and bureaucracy, and established the Law Enforcement Partner Engagement Council to create direct connectivity with the state and local partners who rely on FBI resources every day. And we are investing in the next generation by adding 50 seats to our National Academy classes and expanding counter-UAS training for major events through the National Counter-UAS Training Center, which resumes classes August 1 after surging resources to help secure the 2026 World Cup. This is how the FBI should operate: listen to our partners, cut the bureaucracy, put proven tools in their hands, and deliver results for the American people. -DKP 🇺🇸

President Droupadi Murmu received first copies of publications on her Presidency from Vice President of India Shri C.P. Radhakrishnan who formally released these at a function held at Rashtrapati Bhavan. Dr L. Murugan, Minister of State for Information & Broadcasting and Parliamentary Affairs was also present on the occasion. The publications which were released today are - Rashtrapati Bhavan: Rashtra Ka Bhavan; Seva Aur Samvedana; Samaveshi Sahbhagita; Bharatiyata Ka Utsav; and Ama Rashtrapati - Ama Gourav: an Odia collection of articles written by eminent persons. Speaking on the occasion, the President expressed confidence that these illustrated compilations will introduce readers to the traditions, functioning and multiple facets of Rashtrapati Bhavan. She stated that their true significance lies in their ability to inspire fellow citizens to move forward on the path of progress while taking pride in their heritage.

Everyone is talking about stealth fighters. Almost nobody is talking about the system that actually wins wars. Modern air combat isn’t fighter vs fighter. It’s sensor vs sensor. Network vs network. Kill Web vs Kill Web. Satellites. AWACS. Mountain radars. Drones. Electronic warfare. Air defence. Precision missiles. Naval strike groups. Individually, they’re powerful. Connected together, they become a Kill Web. That’s why the question isn’t: “How stealthy is the J-20?” The real question is: Can any aircraft survive a fully integrated, multi-domain Kill Web? 🎬 My latest 100-second documentary explores how modern air warfare is changing—and why networks, not individual platforms, will define the next conflict. Inspired by my book, Air Warfare in the Network Age, the documentary brings the concepts of the Kill Web, network-centric warfare, and next-generation air power to life through cinematic visuals. Watch till the end. Your view of air warfare may never be the same. #AirPower #IAF #PLAAF #KillWeb #AirWarfareInTheNetworkAge Video

Osan Air Base, South Korea, has confirmed a "ground mishap" and established a 1,000-foot safety cordon around the incident, stating that reports claiming the base was being evacuated are false. According to Reuters, the incident involves white phosphorus, a military material commonly used in smoke screens and incendiary munitions. However, Osan Air Base's statement does not identify the material involved or provide details on the nature or cause of the mishap. At this time, no injuries have been announced and the base has not indicated to what degree the incident has affected normal operations.

Axios reports that senior Trump administration officials believe sustained economic pressure may ultimately inflict more damage on Iran than an expanded bombing campaign, pointing to growing signs of financial strain inside the country. According to Axios, U.S. officials cite intelligence indicating Iran is struggling to fund proxy forces, facing gasoline shortages, and under increasing financial pressure from sanctions led by Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent. Officials argue those economic measures, combined with a U.S. naval blockade, could prove more effective over time than additional airstrikes. Axios also reports Iran continues to seek sanctions relief and access to frozen assets through indirect talks mediated by Oman, Qatar, and Pakistan, while the Trump administration insists any agreement must also address Tehran's remaining nuclear material. The report notes President Trump's decision to pause strikes followed military concerns over air defense interceptor stockpiles but says officials characterize those warnings as a risk assessment rather than the primary driver of the decision. Eduardo spat for the fifth time in seven years on Wednesday, and the recipient had a drone. You need to know what the count means before the drone matters. An alpaca's spit is not saliva. It is the contents of one of three forestomach chambers, brought back up the oesophagus and delivered about three metres with the accuracy of a man throwing a dart at a wall he is leaning against. It carries partly fermented grass, gastric acid at somewhere near pH 2, and a smell that people on the receiving end describe as permanent. It does not come out of fabric. It does not come out of hair. It does not come out of the memory. Four times in seven years. A fox. A stray dog. A journalist who got too close to the smaller ones. A man from the council, who did come back, but in sealed eyewear. That is the entire system. He almost never has to. On Wednesday a man was flying a drone from the footpath, low, in passes, the way they do once they have found something photogenic. The flock bunched. The orphan lamb, who thinks it is an alpaca, went and stood at Eduardo's shoulder with its ears flat, being no help whatsoever. Eduardo watched two passes. Then he walked, unhurried, across sixty metres of field to the fence line nearest the man. He did not spit at the drone. There is no teaching a drone anything. He spat at the operator. The drone came down in the hedge. The man went back to his car at a pace suggesting he had reconsidered a number of things, and somewhere on the road home he will have understood that it is not going to wash out, that he is going to have to explain it, and that no version of the explanation does him any credit at all. Eduardo went back to the geometric centre of the field and hummed once. He has never yet had to do it twice to the same person.

Transit patterns diverge #MarineTraffic data highlights diverging patterns across two of the world's most strategically important maritime chokepoints. Between 24 and 26 July, the Strait of Hormuz recorded 29 verified crossings, including 21 vessels exiting the Middle East Gulf and 8 entering. Routing remained evenly split, with 14 transits using the Iranian Unilateral Scheme, 14 classified as Route Undetermined, and one using the Hormuz Traffic Separation Scheme. By comparison, Bab el-Mandeb recorded 100 verified crossings, with 51 vessels entering the Red Sea and 49 exiting. Ninety vessels followed the Traffic Separation Scheme, while 10 completed dark transits. Several vessels that had previously delayed or reversed course later completed their crossings, suggesting operators are continuing to assess risk dynamically rather than avoiding the route altogether. No vote, no debate, no announcement, just a date passing quietly in a summer when everyone was looking elsewhere. Those still working the Borders this week are here on leave that expires on 1 October, and when they fly out that is the end of it. Understand what is walking out. Six New Zealanders spent three months in one Northumberland valley last year and sheared nearly 90,000 sheep. Fifteen thousand head each, across farms from the Scottish Borders down to County Durham. They have been coming into Coquetdale for over thirty years. Since 2011 a concession has let up to 75 of them in each spring, and between them they take the wool off one and a half to two million British sheep in a window a few weeks long. The Home Office rejected the application on 2 February. Twenty-six days of farmers writing to their MPs got it reinstated on 10 March for one final year, with a line about the sector having had fourteen years to train British workers and now being expected to transition to domestic labour. Here is what that sentence is standing on. British Wool trains over 800 people a year, most of those courses are basic level, and most of the people on them are sheep farmers learning to do their own flock. Training was never the bottleneck. A top shearer clears a ewe in two or three minutes, calm hands, no panic in the animal, hundreds a day for weeks on end, and reaching that standard takes years of conditioning and a place in a global trade that follows the season around the planet. Fourteen million breeding ewes. A few weeks to do them all. A sheep left in fleece gets eaten alive by maggots, so the job is not optional and the date is not negotiable. Next spring those farms make phone calls that nobody answers. Seventy-five shearers, once a year, and a government that could not find room for them. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/SamaHoole/status/2081819072086319404#m

اسلام آباد: 28 جولائی 2026. وزیرِ اعظم محمد شہباز شریف کی زیر صدارت ملک میں جاری مون سون بارشوں اور ان کے نتیجے میں سیلابی صورتحال پر جائزہ اجلاس آج اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا وزیرِ اعظم نے ہدایت کی کہ این ڈی ایم اے، پی ڈی ایم ایز اور صوبائی حکومتوں کے ساتھ مسلسل رابطے میں رہے. تمام ادارے جاری مون سون کے نتیجے میں کسی بھی ہنگامی صورتحال سے نمٹنے کیلئے ہر دم تیار رہیں. این ڈی ایم اے تمام وفاقی و صوبائی اداروں کو مون سون کی صورتحال اور متوقع بارشوں کی اطلاعات بروقت پہنچائیں. وفاقی وزیرِ منصوبہ بندی روزانہ کی بنیادوں پر فلڈ کمیٹی کے اجلاس کی صدارت کریں اور صورتحال کے جائزے کے بعد لائحہ عمل طے کریں. شمالی علاقہ جات میں گلوف و طوفانی ریلوں کے حوالے سے پیشگی اطلاعات کے نظام کو بھرپور طریقے سے فعال رکھا جائے. وزیرِ اعظم نے گفتگو میں کہا پاکستان کا ماحول دشمن گیسوں کے اخراج میں حصہ معمولی ہے مگر موسمیاتی تبدیلی کے مضر اثرات پاکستان کو بری طرح متاثر کر رہے ہیں. موسمیاتی تبدیلی کے مضر اثرات کے پیش نظر حکومت طویل، وسط اور قلیل مدتی اقدامات پر تیزی سے کام کر رہی ہے. این ڈی ایم اے تمام اداروں کے تعاون سے یہ یقینی بنائے کہ مون سون کے جاری اسپیل میں جانی و مالی نقصان کو روکا جائے. اجلاس کو این ڈی ایم اے، گلگت بلتستان و آزاد کشمیر سمیت چاروں صوبوں کے چیف سیکریٹریز نے حالیہ مون سون اور اس کے نتیجے میں نقصانات، ریسکیو و بحالی کے اقدامات پر بریفنگ دی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ این ڈی ایم اے ملک کے شمالی علاقوں میں مون سون سے پیدا ہونے والی سیلابی صورتحال اور سندھ و بلوچستان میں جاری گرمی کی شدید لہر کے حوالے سے صوبائی حکومتوں و اداروں کو تمام تر معاونت و وسائل فراہم کر رہا ہے. آئندہ دو روز میں آزاد کشمیر و گلگت بلتستان اور جنوبی سندھ میں مون سون بارشوں کے ایک بڑے اسپیل کی توقع ہے. اس کے علاوہ ستمبر کے دوسرے ہفتے سے ملک بھر میں مون سون کا ایک بڑا سپیل بھی متوقع ہے. وزیرِ اعظم کی ہدایت پر قائم کردہ فلڈ کمیٹی کا اجلاس باقائدگی سے منعقد ہو رہا ہے جس میں تمام متعلقہ ادارے موجودہ صورتحال پر کڑی نظر رکھنے کے ساتھ ساتھ ریسکیو و ریلیف اور بحالی کے اقدامات کا جامع لائحہ عمل مرتب کرکے اسکا نفاذ یقینی بنا رہے ہیں. اجلاس کو مزید بتایا گیا کہ موجودہ مون سون اسیپل مین اب تک 110 اموات جبکہ 360 لوگ زخمی ہوئے، 796 مکانات کو نقصان پہنچا جبکہ 376 مویشی ہلاک ہوئے. اجلاس کو باتایا گیا کہ عالمی سطح پر جاری ایل-نینو (El-Nino) کی وجہ سے پاکستان کے شمالی علاقہ جات میں موجود گلیشیئرز کے پگھلنے کے تناسب میں اضافہ ہوا ہے جسکی وجہ سے آئندہ ایک ماہ میں گلوف و سیلابی ریلوں کا خطرہ لاحق ہے. ممکنہ طور پر متاثرہ علاقوں کی نشاندہی کرکے تمام تر حفاظتی اقدامات اٹھائے جا رہے ہیں. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ وسطی پنجاب بشمول لاہور میں شہری سیلابی صورتحال پر قابو پانے کیلئے فوری اقدامات اٹھائے گئے جبکہ کچھ علاقوں میں برساتی نالوں میں سیلابی ریلوں کی وجہ سے زرعی زمین زیر آب ہے جس سے نکاسی کا کام جاری ہے. ڈیرہ غازی خان اور اس ملحقہ علاقوں میں بھی سیلابی ریلوں کی صورتحال اس وقت قابو میں ہے. اجلاس کو این ایچ اے کی جانب سے مٹی کے تودے گرنے سے سڑکوں کی بندش اور انکی بحالی پر بھی بریفنگ دی گئی. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ 106 مقامات پر سڑکوں کی بندش کو بروقت اقدامات سے بحال کر دیا گیا ہے. اجلاس کو بتایا گیا کہ وزارت آئی ٹی کی جانب سے نیشنل ایمرجنسی و ٹیلی کمیونیکیشن سینٹر فعال ہے. کسی بھی موبائل فون سے ہنگامی صورتحال میں مدد کی کال پر فوری طور پر ریسکیو 1122 فعال ہوکر ریسکیو و ریلیف اقدامات کیلئے موقع پر پہنچتی ہے. مون سون کے دوران برساتی پانی کو سٹور کرنے کے لئے ملک کے مختلف مقامات پر 700 مقامات کی نشاندہی کی گئی ہے، تاکہ خشک موسم کے دوران وہ پانی زراعت کے لئے استعمال کیا جاسکے۔ بریفنگ وزیرِ اعظم نے این ڈی ایم اے، پی ڈی ایم ایز، صوبائی حکومتوں اور تمام متعلقہ اداروں کی حالیہ مون سون کی پیشگی اطلاعات، تیاری اور ریسکیو و ریلیف کے اقدامات پر پزیرائی کی. اجلاس میں وفاقی وزراء خواجہ محمد آصف، احسن اقبال، اعظم نذیر تارڑ، ڈاکٹر مصدق ملک، رانا تنویر حسین، محمد اورنگزیب، انجینئیر امیر مقام، عطاء اللہ تارڑ، شزہ فاطمہ خواجہ، سردار اویس خان لغاری، میاں محمد معین وٹو، مشیر وزیرِ اعظم رانا ثناء اللہ، چیئرمین این ڈی ایم اے لیفٹینینٹ جنرل انعام حیدر ملک اور متعلقہ اعلی حکام نے شرکت کی. Prof. (Dr.) M. Srinivas, Member (Health), NITI Aayog, attended the AIIMS Symposium on "Lifestyle & Diet: Nutrition, Wellness and Clinical Practice" as the Chief Guest. Organised by the Department of Physiology, AIIMS New Delhi, the symposium brought together experts to deliberate on the role of nutrition and lifestyle in improving health outcomes. Delivering the keynote address, Prof. (Dr.) Srinivas highlighted that India is facing a triple burden of malnutrition, comprising persistent undernutrition, micronutrient deficiencies, and the rising prevalence of overweight, obesity, and diet-related non-communicable diseases (NCDs). He emphasised the need to strengthen nutrition education, routine screening, behaviour change initiatives, and research and surveillance to support evidence-based policymaking. Reiterating that a healthier population is fundamental to achieving the vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047, he called for a comprehensive and preventive approach to improving public health. #PMOIndia #PreventiveHealthcare #Nutrition @PMOIndia @narendramodi @Rao_InderjitS @MIB_India @PIB_India @DDNewslive @ashoklahiribjp

Project UDAAN is helping students in the Pooh Aspirational Block of Kinnaur district, Himachal Pradesh, overcome learning barriers and achieve better academic outcomes under the Aspirational Blocks Programme (ABP). دفتر والی طالبان در پنجشیر از فروش شش هزار و ۷۵۵ قیراط زمرد استخراج‌شده از معادن این ولایت به ارزش ۱۴ میلیون و ۴۵ هزار و ۸۰۰ افغانی خبر داده‌ است. سیف‌الدین لتون، سخن‌گوی والی طالبان در پنجشیر گفته است که این مقدار زمرد امروز (سه‌شنبه، ۶ اسد) از طریق داوطلبی به تاجران داخلی فروخته شده است. او افزوده است که این مقدار زمرد در دو هفته‌ی اخیر از معادن ولسوالی حصه‌ اول پنجشیر استخراج شده بود. طالبان از زمان تسلط دوباره بر افغانستان به‌صورت مرتب معادن زمرد پنجشیر را استخراج و محصولات آن را به فروش رسانده‌اند. این گروه می‌گوید که ۱۰ درصد از پول حاصل از فروش زمرد پنجشیر را دریافت می‌کند و متباقی آن سهم شرکت‌های قراردادی است. طالبان علاوه بر زمرد، معادن طلا، بیروج، یاقوت و گرین‌گارنت پنجشیر را نیز استخراج می‌کنند.

When you look inside a reactor’s core, do you notice that captivating blue glow? That is the ‘Cherenkov effect’ at work! It is named after the physicist who was born #onthisday in 1904. While studying the effects of radiation emitted by sources such as radium, passing through various fluids, Pavel Cherenkov observed a blue-ish light emitted by a radioactive source placed in water. This phenomenon was later explained by Igor Tamm and Ilya Frank: charged particles are disturbing electrons as the particles move faster than the speed of light in the insulating medium like water. This is the ‘Cherenkov effect,’ and he along with Tamm and Frank earned the 1958 @NobelPrize in Physics "for the discovery and the interpretation of the Cherenkov effect". 🔗atoms.iaea.org/4fyYErJ Video

Upton Sinclair is also responsible for something else that passes without notice in our lives: the way we use shirt collars to talk about class. About fifteen years after publishing The Jungle, Sinclair wrote "The Brass Check," which was a muckraking expose on American newsrooms. In it, he described the office clerks upstairs as wearing white collar dress shirts, while the people in the mailroom below as wearing blue collar button-ups. This taxonomic shorthand — white collar vs blue collar — would become a popular way for writers to sidestep the uncomfortable discussion of class throughout the 20th century. Sinclair suggested that the ability to wear a white dress shirt allowed office clerks and middle managers to see themselves as socially distinct from laborers, even if they shared similar interests. An excerpt: "It is a fact with which every union workingman is familiar, that his most bitter despisers are the petty underlings of the business world, the poor office-clerks, who are often the worst exploited of proletarians, but who, because they are allowed to wear a white collar and to work in the office with the boss, regard themselves as members of the capitalist class." Of course, there were other dynamics at the time, such as race, but this taxonomic device (white collar, blue collar) continues to be popular today, especially in a post-industrial economy. Разом з помийкою "Трухою" на мене до суду також має подати і громадянин РФ Сеяр Куршутов. Це той, який за даними медіа заробляв на держконтрактах в МО до приходу Федорова Х2 від ринкової вартості дронів, організувавши схему завищення ціни через перепродаж комплектуючих своїм фірмам-прокладкам. БЕБ розслідує кримінальне провадження № 72025001420000026 щодо цього, але підозр досі чомусь нема. Куршутов під санкціями. Його ІПН бʼється в російських реєстрах. Він хоче далі красти бюджетні кошти, тому атакує. Як і "Труха", що служить корупціонерам і русні. Для мене за честь мати таких ворогів.

Бачу, як помийка "Труха" не заспокоюється, і ширить фейки проти мене та звинувачує у офіційній сплаті податків. Так, на відміну від помийки, я податки плачу. Ютуб приносить мені дохід, як і ФОП, і я не ховаю це від податкової. Ще й своїх майже 11 млн грн на армію задонатив. При цьому "Труха" активно просуває наратив, що не можна донатити і допомагати армії. Чому? Це формальний власник «Трухи» фунт Микола Удянський в компанії братів Асхабових у Харкові та на Балі разом з іншими кадирівцями. Брати Асхабови — вихованці клубу «Ахмат», які публічно називали своїм «шефом» Рамзана Кадирова (фото 3-4 — якраз вони з Кадировим). У центрі першого фото — члени ОЗУ Залютінські, які тероризували харківських фермерів. У 2021 році їх затримали у справі про вимагання $700 тис. у місцевого фермера. Цікаві друзі в Удянського. А ще цікавіші його власники.

Думаю, всі вже бачили нове інтерв’ю президента. На жаль, у ньому ми так і не отримали відповідь на питання, яке ставлять люди на протестах по всій країні. Я переконаний, що слухати свій народ – це ознака сили, і сподіваюсь, що президент таки нас почує. Адже без повноцінної комунікації в суспільстві наростатимуть фрустрація і зневіра, а це точно не те, з чим нам варто заходити в і так надважку зиму. বিস্তারিত: বাংলাদেশিদের জন্য মালয়েশিয়ার শ্রমবাজার দ্রুত পুনঃউন্মুক্ত ও কর্মী নিয়োগ প্রক্রিয়া সহজীকরণের লক্ষ্যে উভয় দেশের মধ্যে এক উচ্চপর্যায়ের বৈঠক অনুষ্ঠিত হয়েছে। মঙ্গলবার (২৮ জুলাই) পুত্রজায়ায় মালয়েশিয়ার মানবসম্পদ মন্ত্রণালয় এবং বাংলাদেশের প্রতিনিধিদলের মধ্যে এই গুরুত্বপূর্ণ দ্বিপাক্ষিক আলোচনা সম্পন্ন হয়। বৈঠকে বাংলাদেশের পক্ষে প্রবাসী কল্যাণ ও বৈদেশিক কর্মসংস্থান মন্ত্রী আরিফুল হক চৌধুরী এবং প্রধানমন্ত্রীর উপদেষ্টা মাহদী আমিন উপস্থিত ছিলেন। আলোচনায় উভয় দেশের অভ্যন্তরীণ চাহিদা ও দ্বিপাক্ষিক স্বার্থের কথা বিবেচনা করে কর্মী পাঠানোর বিভিন্ন ধাপ, সময়সীমা এবং নির্দিষ্ট কার্যপদ্ধতি (এসওপি) নিয়ে বিস্তারিত পর্যালোচনা করা হয়। মালয়েশিয়ার মানবসম্পদমন্ত্রী আর রামানান এক বিবৃতিতে জানিয়েছেন, আগামী কয়েক দিনের মধ্যেই শ্রমবাজার চালুর বিষয়ে চূড়ান্ত ও আনুষ্ঠানিক ঘোষণা আসতে পারে। বৈঠকে দুই দেশের কৌশলগত প্রয়োজন ও অর্থনৈতিক চাহিদাকে অগ্রাধিকার দিয়ে বিদ্যমান প্রক্রিয়াকে আরও গতিশীল করার ওপর জোর দেওয়া হয়। চলতি বছরের শেষ পর্যন্ত বিদ্যমান সমঝোতা স্মারকের (এমওইউ) মেয়াদ থাকলেও, নিছক চুক্তির আনুষ্ঠানিকতার চেয়ে বাস্তব পরিস্থিতির প্রেক্ষাপটে শ্রমবাজার উন্মুক্ত করাকেই এখন মূল অগ্রাধিকার হিসেবে দেখা হচ্ছে। বিশেষ করে মালয়েশিয়ার রেস্তোরাঁ ও পামওয়েল খাতসহ অন্যান্য সম্ভাবনাময় ক্ষেত্রে বাংলাদেশি কর্মীদের ব্যাপক চাহিদা তৈরি হওয়ায় দ্রুততম সময়ে কর্মী পাঠাতে উভয় দেশই নমনীয় ও ইতিবাচক নীতি অনুসরণে নীতিগতভাবে সম্মত হয়েছে। মালয়েশিয়া সরকারের শীর্ষ পর্যায়ের নির্দেশনার আলোকে অগ্রাধিকারপ্রাপ্ত খাতগুলোতে দ্রুত কর্মী নিয়োগের ব্যবস্থা নেওয়ার সিদ্ধান্ত হয়েছে। প্রাথমিকভাবে কর্মী পাঠানো শুরুর পর নিরাপত্তা ও অন্যান্য টেকনিক্যাল বিষয়গুলো পর্যায়ক্রমে সমাধান করা হবে বলে জানানো হয়। উভয় পক্ষই আশ্বস্ত করেছে যে, শ্রমবাজারের বর্তমান স্থবিরতা ও সংকট কাটিয়ে উঠতে এবং পারস্পরিক স্বার্থ রক্ষায় বাংলাদেশ ও মালয়েশিয়া সরকার অত্যন্ত গুরুত্বের সাথে যৌথভাবে কাজ করে যাচ্ছে।

⦿ लोक परीक्षा (अनुचित साधन निवारण) संशोधन विधेयक, 2026 का विवरण पढ़कर पता चलता है कि मोदी सरकार शिक्षा व्यवस्था को सुधारने के लिए गंभीर नहीं है ⦿ 2024 में भी सरकार ने इस बिल को ऐतिहासिक बताया था- लेकिन कुछ नहीं हुआ। ये कानून मोदी सरकार की विफलता का स्मारक है ⦿ NEET-UG 2024 पेपर लीक की तहकीकात में जिन 45 लोगों के खिलाफ चार्जशीट दाखिल की गई थी, उसमें से 44 लोगों को बेल मिल चुकी है- ये शर्मनाक है ⦿ जब 2024 में पेपर लीक हुआ था, तब भी धर्मेंद्र प्रधान सच्चाई मानने को तैयार नहीं थे और 2026 में भी उनका यही रवैया था ⦿ शर्म आनी चाहिए कि जिस मंत्री के रहते 21 बच्चों ने जान दे दी, मोदी सरकार उनका सम्मान करती है ⦿ परीक्षा में सुधार और पेपर लीक माफिया के खिलाफ कदम उठाने के बदले प्रधानमंत्री मोदी इंस्टाग्राम पर ध्यान देने को कहते हैं ⦿ RSS ने देश के शिक्षा संस्थानों पर कब्जा कर लिया है ⦿ युवा अपने अधिकारों के लिए दिल्ली में जुटे थे। आंदोलन में किसी को लाठी पड़ी, किसी का सिर फूट गया, लेकिन वे डिगे नहीं ⦿ इस आंदोलन में अगर हमने इंसानियत देखी तो दूसरी तरफ युवाओं पर बेरहमी से किए गए लाठीचार्ज को भी देखा ⦿ हम ये नहीं भूल सकते कि एक पुलिसवाले ने लड़की को थप्पड़ जड़ा, एक लड़की के प्राइवेट पार्ट में डंडा मारा। युवाओं पर पैलेट गन का इस्तेमाल किया ⦿ हमें जवाब दिया जाए कि किसने लाठीचार्ज, पैलेट गन और आंसू गैस के गोले छोड़ने का आदेश दिया? सरकार और गृह मंत्री अमित शाह को इसपर जवाब देना होगा : लोकसभा में 'लोक परीक्षा (अनुचित साधन निवारण) संशोधन विधेयक, 2026' पर कांग्रेस के उपनेता @GauravGogoiAsm जी का पूरा वक्तव्य- Video

The initiative represents an important step towards demonstrating how clean energy, sustainable agriculture, and community ownership can come together to create resilient and inclusive rural livelihoods. During the visit, the ICRIER team interacted with the on-ground PGPL team, farmers, and the EPC partner to gain a deeper understanding of the project's implementation status, validate key structural design aspects of the pilot, and discuss the upcoming milestones towards its successful commissioning. Hearing directly from the women farmers and witnessing their enthusiasm for the project reinforced the transformative potential of this model. در گزارش یوناما درباره‌ی وضعیت حقوق بشر آمده است که طالبان در هرات، دست‌کم ۱۷ نفر از معترضانی را که علیه بازداشت زنان و دختران به‌دلیل پوشش در منطقه‌ی جبرئیل هرات تظاهرات کرده بودند، بازداشت کرده‌اند. در این گزارش درباره‌ی سرنوشت افراد بازداشت‌شده توضیح داده نشده است. به‌تاریخ نهم جون، برابر با ۱۹ جوزا، شماری از باشندگان منطقه‌ی هزاره‌نشین جبرئیل در هرات علیه بازداشت زنان و دختران به‌دلیل چگونگی پوشش تظاهرات کردند. یوناما گفته است که این تظاهرات زمانی به خشونت کشید شد که نیروهای لباس‌شخصی طالبان شروع به لت‌وکوت و تیرانداری به‌سوی معترضان کردند.‌ در گزارش یوناما آمده است که نیروهای طالبان یک پسر را با شلیک گلوله کشتند و شماری از معترضان را مورد ضرب‌وشتم و تیراندازی قرار دادند که در نتیجه دست‌کم چهار نفر زخمی شدند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258123

دفتر هیأت معاونت سازمان ملل متحد (یوناما) در گزارش خود درباره‌ی وضعیت حقوق بشر گفته است که پس از بازداشت شماری از زنان به‌دلیل چگونگی پوشش توسط مأموران امر به معروف طالبان در هرات، حضور زنان در جاده‌های هرات به‌دلیل ترس از بازداشت کاهش یافته است. براساس این گزارش، از شش تا هشت ماه جون، مأموران امر به معروف طالبان در هرات دست‌کم ۳۰ زن و دختر را به‌دلیل نپوشیدن چادری بازداشت و به زندان انتقال دادند. این زنان و دختران در هشت جون پس از سپردن تعهد دوباره آزاد شدند. در گزارش یوناما آمده است که کارزار تطبیق حجاب مورد قبول طالبان در هرات از سال گذشته‌ی میلادی شروع شده بود و این گروه با ایجاد ایست‌های بازرسی، زنان بدون چادری را نگه می‌‌داشت تا بستگان آنان چادر بیاورند. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/258119

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, today briefed the diplomatic corps and the media, at the ASEAN Headquarters/ASEAN Secretariat, on the key outcomes of the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting (AMM), Post-Ministerial Conferences (PMC), 27th ASEAN Plus Three Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, 16th East Asia Summit Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, 33rd ASEAN Regional Forum, and Related Meetings, held in Manila, the Philippines. The series of meetings were held from 18 to 23 July 2026 and concluded with the commemorative events marking the 50th anniversary of the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC) on 24 July 2026, including the signing ceremony of the Instrument of Accession to the TAC for Lithuania, Sweden, Romania, and Poland, and the High-level Conference of the High Contracting Parties to the TAC. Representatives from ASEAN Committees in Third Countries and International Organisations (ACTCs) also participated in the briefing virtually. SG Dr. Kao shared the key outcomes of the meetings, emphasising ASEAN's continued central role in shaping the regional architecture, the enduring value of ASEAN-led mechanisms in fostering dialogue and cooperation, and the strong commitment of ASEAN's external partners to supporting the implementation of the ASEAN 2045: Our Shared Future. The series of meetings also laid the groundwork for the upcoming 49th ASEAN Summit and related Summits, to be held in Manila, in November this year. The Briefing was livestreamed to the public via the ASEAN Secretariat's YouTube channel.

A question keeps coming up in Indian tech circles — why doesn't India have its own Palantir? This piece argues it is the wrong question, and that the honest answer is more interesting than the one people expect. First, what Palantir actually is. - Strip away the spy-thriller image, and its real product is dull — software that takes an organisation's data, stored in twenty systems that don't talk to each other, and joins it into one view. - The US spy agencies had that fragmentation problem, so the CIA's venture arm funded a company to fix it. That's the origin. But here's the thing the piece points out. - India already built infrastructure of the same scale of ambition, in Aadhaar and UPI. And it did the exact opposite of Palantir. Palantir is a private company. - The US government hired it to build the system that connects all its scattered data, and over the years it has come to depend on that company completely. - It cannot easily replace it now. India did the reverse with UPI and Aadhaar. - The government built the core system itself and owns it. - Companies like PhonePe and Google Pay build apps that use it, but none of them owns the system underneath, so the government is not tied to any single one of them. An 'Indian Palantir' would mean a private company owning that core system. That is the opposite of how India has worked, so the piece argues it would not really fit. Still, India's army and police have the same problem Palantir was built for. Their data is spread across many agencies that do not share it with each other. So could an Indian company build something like Palantir just for defence? The piece says the real hurdle is not a shortage of engineers, or even money. It is trust. The government does not trust private companies enough to hand them work this sensitive. @AvadhanyGirish writes in @SwarajyaMag — India Doesn't Need A Palantir. On 6 February 1190, at least 17 children and adults were massacred in Norwich, England, perhaps by English Crusaders, and thrown down a well. In 2004 archaeologists dug up their skeletal remains. In 2020, BBC reported that researchers now had the technology to sequence the victims’ genome. The findings were published in that year’s issue of the journal Biology Today. The victims were found to be, genetically, Ashkenazi Jews. A very recent group, formed by tricklimg migrations of Jews northward from the western Mediterranean. In 2026, my own DNA was analyzed by a nonprofit DNA research lab. This week they let me know that three of the Norwich Massacre victims, three piles of bones pulled out of the well, a man, a young girl and a toddler boy, were my own very very distant relatives. I find this stunning. Also far too awe-inspiring and subtle for facile jokes or simplistic politics. Just one remark: state of the art genetics and identity politics, not to mention postcolonialist theories, are embarking on a roller coaster. New findings will affect not only our collective histories, but change the very texture of the stories we individually tell about ourselves. For the sadder, perhaps, but ultimately - as new vistas open for every aspect of our past - for the better too. bbc.com/news/uk-england-norf…

Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif's Message on the Occasion of World Hepatitis Day, 28 July 2026. On World Hepatitis Day, Pakistan joins the international community in reaffirming its unwavering commitment to eliminating hepatitis and protecting our people from this devastating disease. Pakistan remains among the countries with the highest burden of Hepatitis C and has been confronting this serious public health challenge for decades.Ensuring equitable access for every citizen to quality screening, diagnosis and treatment services for the prevention and control of the most severe and life threatening forms of hepatitis remains one of the Government's foremost priorities. Recognising that Hepatitis C is both preventable and curable, the Government of Pakistan launched the Prime Minister's National Programme for the Elimination of Hepatitis C Infection in 2025. This historic and unprecedented initiative aims to provide millions of Pakistanis with free and timely screening, confirmatory testing and effective treatment. Under this Programme's implementation, screening, diagnostic and treatment services have already commenced in Islamabad, with all major public healthcare facilities and hospitals actively participating. Furthermore, mobile screening has also been launched to ensure these essential services reach communities more effectively. Individuals requiring further diagnostic evaluation and treatment are being enrolled in the Programme without any financial burden. To curb the spread of this deadly disease, the Government has imposed a complete ban on the manufacture, distribution and reuse of substandard syringes. In this regard, strict directives have been issued to ensure compliance with infection prevention and hygiene protocols in hospitals and healthcare facilities, while accountability has been strengthened for any negligence in their implementation. The Federal Government remains committed to making the best possible use of available resources while further strengthening collaboration with provincial governments, development partners, healthcare professionals and the private sector to minimise the impact of this disease and ensure that no deserving patient is deprived of treatment. Success in the fight against hepatitis and other communicable diseases requires not only the Government's efforts but also the active participation of every individual and the wider community. I urge all Pakistanis to undergo timely Hepatitis C screening, encourage their family members, friends and colleagues to get tested, and adopt safe healthcare and hygiene practices that help prevent the spread of infection. Early diagnosis and prompt treatment save lives. Our doctors, nurses, laboratory professionals and frontline healthcare workers are at the forefront of this national effort to prevent and combat disease. Their dedication and service deserve our highest appreciation. I urge them to continue setting exemplary standards of professional excellence, commitment and compassion in the discharge of their duties. On this World Hepatitis Day, let us renew our pledge to build a healthier Pakistan. I am confident that through collective efforts, close cooperation, scientific innovation, public participation and the blessings of Almighty Allah, we will achieve our national commitment and global goal of eliminating Hepatitis C as a major public health threat by 2030, Insha'Allah. Pakistan Zindabad.

"Mainland Conducts First Fisheries Scientific Survey East of Taiwan [title] At midnight in mid-July, in the waters east of Taiwan Island, the *Lanhai 201*—a comprehensive fisheries scientific research vessel from the East China Sea Fisheries Research Institute (under the Chinese Academy of Fishery Sciences, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs)—was a hive of activity. As the survey nets were slowly hoisted and the collected samples poured into baskets, a pungent, briny scent of the sea filled the air. Yet, Dr. Shi Yongchuang, an associate researcher at the institute, excitedly removed his mask and leaned in close to examine these small creatures from relatively unfamiliar waters. For the research team—whose members have an average age of just 35—this marked their first foray into this traditional fishing ground of Chinese fishermen. To them, this was a voyage carrying forward a historic mission. They also took pride in arriving in these waters under Chinese jurisdiction amidst "roiling waves." On July 23—seven days after the *Lanhai 201* set sail—the comprehensive scientific survey of resources and the environment in the waters east of Taiwan Island was officially announced. During those seven days, *Global Times* reporters accompanying the *Lanhai 201* on its pioneering voyage not only witnessed the beauty of these "ancestral waters" but also personally experienced harassment by external forces. Zheng Hanfeng, the chief scientist of the expedition and deputy director of the East China Sea Fisheries Research Institute, told reporters that the voyage's most significant milestone was filling the gap in fisheries surveys for the waters east of Taiwan, thereby completing the geographic coverage of scientific surveys regarding fisheries resources within my country's Exclusive Economic Zone. Scientific researchers aboard the *Lanhai 201* employ various technical methods to survey fishery resources and the marine environment in the waters off eastern Taiwan. (Photo by Hu Yuwei) "Fulfilling a mentor's wish: filling the blank spots on the coastal survey map" Working around the clock without sleep became the norm for the scientific team aboard the *Lanhai 201* over the course of seven days. Even after midnight, the deck and laboratories remained brightly lit. What truly excited the team were the successive hauls of the catch; much like opening "blind boxes," they eagerly anticipated a new surprise with every net brought aboard. Even with a small fish that might seem unremarkable to the average person, Dr. Zhao Guoqing and his colleagues from the East China Sea Fisheries Research Institute would meticulously identify and process the specimen. They measured body length and weight one by one, and carefully performed dissections to record the stage of gonad development and stomach fullness. Dr. Zhao explained to the *Global Times* reporter that these seemingly trivial basic biological parameters serve as the cornerstone for subsequent biodiversity analysis and resource assessment. Populations of the same fish species inhabiting different waters can exhibit significant differences in characteristics due to geographical isolation and environmental factors. Zhang Hanye, a researcher and leader of the fish study group, elaborated: "The waters off eastern Taiwan are particularly unique; the seabed features rare, precipitous drops—with depths plunging to between 3,000 and 5,000 meters—which contrasts sharply with the continental shelf characteristics of other domestic coastal areas, where depths typically range from a few dozen to a few hundred meters. Being able to collect firsthand data from these waters—which are part of our own coastal territory—gives us much greater confidence in our scientific analysis." Zhao Guoqing’s focus and dedication stem from a deep sense of mission. He shared a personal regret with the reporter: his mentor had once vied for the National Science and Technology Progress Award for his work on a survey of China's coastal fishery resources. However, on the map of survey stations created by the team at the time, one small area—the waters off eastern Taiwan—had remained blank. 'My teacher often said that our work would only be truly complete once we could conduct a scientific survey there. Now, I have finally fulfilled my teacher’s wish and filled the gap in the map of inshore fishery surveys. As a Chinese person, I feel truly proud at this moment.'" Global Times-China, 26 July

We have always supported open-weight models on Amazon Bedrock, starting back in 2023, and will continue to advocate for open ecosystems. No single model will define AI leadership. Together, they expand access to AI, accelerate innovation, strengthen competition, and give organizations greater control over the technology they build. Successful leadership in AI will not be built around a single model or a single approach. It will be built on broad choice and the infrastructure to run those models securely, reliably, and at scale. While there are elements of the Open Weights and American AI Leadership letter that need further definition over time, we’re supportive of the macro direction and have signed it.

If you wanted attention, DW, all you had to do was ask! In this pathetic documentary, the conclusion came first. Pakistan was then edited to fit it. The method is embarrassingly transparent: 1. Show a radical cleric. 2. Cut to a nuclear facility. 3. Add ominous music. 4. Mention instability. 5. Let insinuation replace evidence. Pakistan is described as having “illegally developed” nuclear weapons. Illegally under which law? Pakistan was never a party to the NPT and therefore did not violate an NPT obligation by acquiring nuclear weapons. DW may disapprove of the program, but moral disapproval is not a legal argument, Folks. Notice the asymmetry in language! India developed nuclear weapons. Pakistan “deceived the world.” India’s programme is treated as a strategic fact. Pakistan’s is narrated as criminal cunning. Mashallah! The documentary briefly mentions 1971, India’s conventional advantage and Pakistan’s loss of faith in external guarantees but refuses to let any of that seriously explain Pakistan’s nuclear choices. Context is included only so it can be ignored. Then comes the old “Islamists might seize the bomb” trope. No evidence of penetration of nuclear command structures is presented. No demonstrated breach is identified. No serious institutional assessment is offered. Just militants somewhere in Pakistan and therefore loose nukes. Even DW’s own interviewees acknowledge centralized command and control, multiple security layers and specialized forces protecting nuclear assets. But every reassuring fact is treated as an inconvenient interruption before the awful soundtrack returns to impending catastrophe. DW uses AQ Khan's case as a permanent substitute for analysing Pakistan’s present nuclear-security architecture. History becomes guilt without expiry, who knew! But that's not all! of course, there comes Kashmir, which is handled with similar intellectual laziness. Instead of seriously examining disputed sovereignty, war, repression, failed diplomacy and competing legal claims, Pakistan’s position is reduced to a psychological obsession arising from its Muslim identity. A retired brigadier making expansive comments about nuclear use is presented as a window into Pakistan’s doctrine. He is not the National Command Authority. He is not the Strategic Plans Division. He is not an official doctrinal document. But guess what! nuance would spoil the drama. The documentary also bundles together military businesses, hospitals, gated housing, blasphemy laws, Imran Khan, Afghan refugees, illegal weapons markets and attacks on Christians. These are serious issues. BUT they are not evidence that Pakistan’s nuclear arsenal is insecure. Here's the central fraud: collapsing four separate questions into one. -Pakistan’s democratic governance. -Its civil-military imbalance. -Its internal security challenges. -Its nuclear command and control. DW treats them as interchangeable because differentiation would require actual analysis. The final product is the standard Western Pakistan story: -Too poor to govern itself. -Too religious to be trusted. -Too militarized to be democratic. -Too unstable to possess nuclear weapons. Pakistan has serious problems. None of them should be denied or romanticized. But a credible documentary would distinguish between nuclear safety, nuclear security, political stability and democratic governance. It would examine institutions, procedures, doctrine and evidence. It would compare Pakistan with other nuclear powers. It would ask whether the risks it highlights are demonstrated, plausible or merely imagined. Strip away the ominous soundtrack and all that remains is a tired collection of stereotypes. The only real danger in this documentary is losing sixty minutes you will never get back. Statement by the CARICOM EPG on the Transmission of the Electoral Calendar The Eminent Persons Group (EPG) of the Caribbean Community (CARICOM) welcomes the publication of the electoral calendar by the Haitian Provisional Electoral Council (CEP). This critical step in the electoral process which provides the dates for the organisation of the general elections, has been eagerly awaited by Haitian stakeholders and also by the international community. The availability of the calendar will no doubt give a boost to the critical ongoing preparatory stages of the electoral process such as the registration of political parties, platforms and coalitions as well as the registration of voters. The EPG underlines the importance of the Provisional Electoral Council working closely with all stakeholders as the preparatory stages for the general elections unfold, and whose first round for the presidency and the legislature, as well as for constitutional reform, will take place on December 13, 2026. The EPG also urges all stakeholders to engage in the process and to assist in ensuring that all the requirements and procedures are fulfilled so that the Haitian people can, through free and credible elections, choose their government and secure the restoration of constitutional order. As highlighted by the CEP, improvements in the overall security situation are critical inputs for the success of the electoral process. More than one month after the devastating earthquakes in Venezuela, we remember those who lost their lives and stand in solidarity with the families and communities rebuilding after tremendous loss and suffering. Recovery efforts must be guided by transparency, accountability, and respect for human rights. Protecting vulnerable communities, ensuring access to information about those who remain missing, and delivering civilian-led humanitarian assistance are essential to an effective and equitable response. In this time of crisis, Venezuela needs democratic institutions capable of responding effectively, safeguarding human rights, and earning the confidence of the people as the country continues to face profound challenges. PROVEA (@_Provea) La falta de una respuesta oportuna del Estado tras el doblete sísmico del 24 de junio reafirmó las fallas estructurales de las instituciones en Venezuela: Ausencia de autoridades en primeras horas, miles de personas en total desasistencia, falta de planificación para refugios y la opacidad en el manejo de la información oficial son parte de una negligencia estatal. Como organización con memoria histórica, advertimos que no puede repetirse la separación forzada de familias, militarización de la atención y el monopolio estatal de la ayuda como lo ocurrido en Vargas en 1999. Exigimos al Estado venezolano transparencia sobre desaparecidos y pacientes pediátricos, protección diferenciada para grupos vulnerables, desmilitarización de la asistencia y retiro de SEBIN/DGCIM de los albergues, y participación real de la sociedad civil en la reconstrucción. La reconstrucción de Venezuela debe ser técnica, pero, sobre todo, democrática. Belgian authorities have arrested a woman who was interning at NATO's Supreme Headquarters Allied Powers Europe (SHAPE) in Mons, Belgium, on suspicion of espionage. The woman, a Canadian citizen of Chinese origin, was detained on Friday, and the Belgian Federal Public Prosecutor's Office announced the arrest on Saturday. Prosecutors suspect that she was spying for a third country and was a member of a criminal organization. Investigators conducted searches at both her home and her workplace at SHAPE. The investigation began when SHAPE's own security services flagged her conduct and reported their concerns to Belgian military intelligence, which subsequently referred the matter to federal prosecutors. SHAPE is NATO's primary military command in Europe, led by the Supreme Allied Commander Europe, and plays a central role in the alliance's operational planning. A SHAPE spokesperson stated that there is no indication that NATO's or SHAPE's operational readiness, command and control arrangements, or ongoing tasks have been affected, confirming that the headquarters continues to operate normally. Authorities have provided few additional details about the case. They have not publicly identified the woman or disclosed the country for which she allegedly spied. This arrest comes amid heightened concerns across Europe regarding foreign intelligence activities targeting NATO institutions and member states. Source: AP, Bloomberg, Washington Post, CBC, Global News. So What The identity of the sponsoring state has not been confirmed. While reports emphasize her Chinese origin, it’s important to note that origin alone is not evidence, and prosecutors have not named anyone specific. It's unlikely that a single intern represents the entire picture; additional handlers or a broader network may be involved. SHAPE, which is NATO's primary military command, is a probable target for any capable hostile service. Although she is individually accused of betraying her country, placing a source within a headquarters like this is standard tradecraft for hostile states, not an exception.
